title: Is Tesana AI worth it?
author: AverageMemeFan
selftext:
I am quite curious about AI game developing. I was wondering if Tesana AI was a good enough site to pay for to just try it out myself. So far I have seen mixed reactions ‘bout. I used to be very hateful toward AI but I have warmed up to it as long as it is not relied on. 

Based on experiencr, would Tesana be worth the price, or are there better alternatives to give AI gaming a try?

comments.author: ScutFarkush
comments.body: I would go with claude code or another standlone LLM and use LOVE2D or GADOT. If i am not mistaken, Tesana holds you hostage in there eco system, meaning it is only playable through them, you can not put it on steam or execute on your pc.

replies.author: AdarfoStelato
replies.body: Can confirm this is true - I just published my first game on Steam made on Tesana and I got over 300 wishlists on it

replies.author: MartinDiavolo1
replies.body: spread the link buddy what game is it??

comments.author: Impressive_Award_679
comments.body:
At the end of the day it looks like a wrapper for a engine like godot. If u are lazy and dont know what you do, u can try it, but it does not really give u any real benefit outside of a more "easy" enviroment maybe. 

u could also just use cursor or codex and work with it in godot projects without the need of paying for tesana. 

Also their advertisement makes me really sceptical all the time. They act like they are costumers while they are the people behind it and then they block you if u ask "too much questions". They claim that everything is ai generated, while u can clearly find alot of the assetts in their promotion videos on free asset sites.

comments.author: slipperyslips
comments.body: All the saas wrappers are not worth using just use claude code or codex with mcp connections for godot or whatever engine your woeking with. Unreal just got official mcp like 2 weeks ago

comments.author: aniketjatav
comments.body: Would love to give you access to my ai game dev platform - [Crayon](https://usecrayon.ai/).  If you'd like to try. Its in free beta so you can make a call. Here's [signup](https://app.usecrayon.ai/signup) if you're interested.

replies.author: AverageMemeFan
replies.body: Checking out the website. Haven’t generated anything but the games look great so far

comments.author: Savage_PrawnYT
comments.body:
Codex + £20 chatgpt subscription + mcp connection to unity (free open source version). That will help you a great deal but will still require a ton of work. There is no escaping that. 

Top tip is don’t ask for code right away. 90% of your time should be spent on planning and specifying design details with the Ai. Then once you are happy ask it to write code. 

By the time you get to the code part you should already know exactly what it’s going to produce. Even. If you can’t fully understand it you will know what it “does”. 

This is not the only answer but it’s just what I found to be decent.

comments.author: vurt72
comments.body:
Build your own, tailored for what you need... 

I use godot, but since i do not know how to use godot i built a level designer for it that fits my game and how i want to build the game. Now i can design my game without promoting.  yes, this takes time (several days, maybe a week), depending on how advanced the game is. My (2D) game is fairly complex (day/night cycles, advanced lighting, water physics, destructible environments, fly to space and land on ground, quite complex), for me it took a week but i am still building it out.
